intro.title: POLID
intro.p1: In 1991, "PoLiD" was the first company in Poland to start producing string mops.
intro.p2: We are a reliable, proven manufacturer — our products sit on the shelves of many wholesalers and supermarkets in Poland and around the world.
intro.p3: Our products combine good quality, functionality and an attractive price, rounded off with a rich colour palette and modern packaging.
intro.p4: We manufacture microfiber, viscose, cotton, cotton-viscose and cotton WRAP mops.

ownBrandSection.title: We manufacture for your own brand
ownBrandSection.text: Have an idea for your own product but no way to start a production line? Talk it through with us and let us manufacture it for you — then launch it under your own company's brand or an entirely new one.

productsPage.title: Our products
productsPage.subtitle: The full range of mop heads

descriptions.microfiber: Microfiber mops for thorough, efficient cleaning of stubborn dirt and polishing all kinds of smooth floors. Absorb over 500 ml of water or liquid.
descriptions.viscoseMix: Very pleasant to the touch and highly absorbent. A rich colour palette suits any interior.
descriptions.viscoseWhite: Classic white with high absorbency — a universal solution for every floor.
descriptions.cottonViscose: A blend of cotton and viscose gives mega absorbency on all floor types.
descriptions.cottonViscose2: A two-colour version of the cotton-viscose mop — mega absorbency on all floors.
descriptions.cotton: Soft, durable and highly absorbent — a great fit for any household.
descriptions.cottonWrap: Picks up dust perfectly, dries quickly, wrings out easily.
